summary: Fireworks AI's official billing FAQ still refers to a $1 credit and explains what happens when it is exhausted. The current pricing page no longer advertises a $1 signup grant, so the actual grant to a new account remains to be verified; this offer has not been personally redeemed. Current self-serve billing is prepaid, not postpaid: usage draws from credits, and continuing after depletion requires a payment method and purchased credits. Auto Reload can purchase credits automatically if enabled. No fixed campaign end date is established.
claim_steps: Create a Fireworks AI account at https://fireworks.ai/signup.
Check your billing dashboard for the $1 starter credit referenced by the official FAQ; a new-account grant has not been confirmed by this audit.
If the credit is granted, use it for eligible pay-per-token inference and monitor your balance.
After depletion, continuing service requires a payment method and purchased credits. Check Auto Reload settings before enabling automatic purchases.

social_proof.title: Fireworks - Pricing
social_proof.text: Pay per token with pre-paid, usage-based billing. Simply add a payment method to buy credits, and usage is then deducted from your balance.

social_proof.title: How do credits work? - Fireworks AI Docs
social_proof.text: What happens when I finish my $1 credit? When you finish your $1 credit, the following occurs: Without payment method: Your account will be suspended until you add a payment method. With payment method: Add credits to continue usage.

social_proof.title: Credit system - Fireworks AI Docs
social_proof.text: Fireworks operates on a pre-paid credits billing system. Add a valid payment method and billing address, then purchase credits before usage. If your credits reach zero and Auto Reload is disabled, usage pauses until you add credits.
